description: This file contains fuzzing functions for Kubernetes API objects, including functions to generate randomized TypeMeta, ObjectMeta, LabelSelector, and other meta objects for testing purposes.

methods.name: genericFuzzerFuncs
methods.description: Provides fuzzing functions for resource.Quantity, int, runtime.TypeMeta, runtime.Object, and runtime.RawExtension.

methods.name: v1FuzzerFuncs
methods.description: Provides fuzzing functions for v1 TypeMeta, ObjectMeta, ResourceVersionMatch, ListMeta, LabelSelector, and ManagedFieldsEntry.

methods.name: v1beta1FuzzerFuncs
methods.description: Provides fuzzing functions for v1beta1 TableOptions and TableRow.
